mapper.select: select complainuser_no from T2000_COMPLAIN_USER where COMPLAINUSER_RESIDENT_NO = #{ResidentNO}
mapper.update: UPDATE T2000_COMPLAIN_USER SET COMPLAINUSER_POST = #{complainuserPost}, COMPLAINUSER_ADDRESS = #{complainuserAddress}, COMPLAINUSER_ADDRESS_DETAIL = #{complainuserAddrDetail}, COMPLAINUSER_TEL = #{complainuserTel}, COMPLAINUSER_PHONE = #{complainuserPhone}, COMPLAINUSER_EMAIL = #{complainuserEmail}, UPDATE_DT = #{updateDt} WHERE COMPLAINUSER_RESIDENT_NO =#{complainuserResidentNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T2000_COMPLAIN_USER ( COMPLAINUSER_NAME, COMPLAINUSER_RESIDENT_NO, COMPLAINUSER_POST, COMPLAINUSER_ADDRESS, COMPLAINUSER_ADDRESS_DETAIL, COMPLAINUSER_TEL, COMPLAINUSER_PHONE, COMPLAINUSER_EMAIL ) VALUES ( #{complainuserName}, #{complainuserResidentNo}, #{complainuserPost}, #{complainuserAddress}, #{complainuserAddrDetail}, #{complainuserTel}, #{complainuserPhone}, #{complainuserEmail} )
